stemBlocks: Compound Z is known to have percentage composition by mass C: 80.0%, H: 6.7%, O: 13.3%. The mass spectrum of compound Z is given showing the mass-to-charge ratio ($m/z$) of the molecular ion and its fragments. The structures shown are representations of the same molecule.
Which of the following could be the structure of Z? ($A_r$ values: C = 12; H = 1; O = 16)
